title: FFe review assessment
description: The only part of a review record produced by a language model. Everything else is gathered deterministically. Enums are closed and strings are bounded so a model cannot widen the vocabulary or pad the output.

decision.description: The recommendation. Advisory only: a human Release Team member decides.

confidence.description: How far the evidence supports the recommendation, not how the model feels about it.

summary.description: One sentence a reviewer can read at a glance.

reasoning.description: Between three and six points, each citing the evidence it rests on.

evidence_refs.description: JSON pointers into the evidence bundle. Checked; an unresolvable pointer invalidates the response.

missing_information.description: Non-empty if and only if the decision is NEEDS_INFORMATION. Each entry actionable.

conditions.description: Conditions under which an approval would hold.

flags.description: Closed vocabulary. A model may not invent a flag.

precedents_applied.description: Ids of learned precedents relied on. Each must be one that was supplied.

disagreement_with_deterministic.description: Required when contradicting a deterministic gate or floor; null otherwise.
